column1: # Every third-party component a build file pulls in outside pub and Cargo
# (LICENSE-001): where it comes from, its licence as read from its source,
# how it ships, the version it was read at, and what the licence was read
# from. test/js/licence_policy.test.js fails on a pull site with no row, a row
# no build file pulls in, a licence licences.tsv does not allow for how the
# component ships, and a pin that is not the build's: a new version is read
# again before its row moves (a pod's version, a pub package's, a download's
# expanded URL or the commit a git source fetches; empty where the source
# itself names its version, or for Gradle, whose POMs the Android build reads).
#   linked   compiled or linked into the app, or shipped beside it as a program
#   shared   a separately shipped shared library the user can replace
#   build    a build tool; nothing of it ships
